scope: Any count, filter or comparison involving hero weight
description: Hero weight is stored in kilograms. Weight 0 and NULL both mean the weight is not recorded: 172 heroes have weight 0 and 64 have NULL, 236 of 750 in total. Zero is not a real body weight and treating it as measured weight distorts counts and averages. The smallest recorded positive weight is 14 kg.

scope: Any count, filter or range over hero height
description: Hero height is stored in centimetres. 155 heroes have height 0 and 58 have NULL, both meaning unrecorded height. Extreme values up to 30480 occur for giant characters and are stored as recorded rather than being errors.

scope: Filtering or interpreting eye, hair and skin colour values
description: Colour identifier 1 has the label No Colour and denotes an unrecorded or absent colour, not a literal colour. It is used for 169 hero eye colours, 246 hair colours and 681 skin colours. Colour labels are stored capitalised, for example Blue, Black and Blond. No Colour must not be counted as a real colour but is the value that represents no eye color.

scope: Counting or filtering heroes by presence of a full name
description: A full name is not recorded for 247 of 750 heroes using two markers: 122 NULL values and 125 literal dash strings. 503 heroes have a substantive full name. Conditions for heroes without a full name must account for both encodings.

scope: Interpreting attribute score values and extremes
description: Attribute scores are integers on a 0 to 100 scale; the observed range is 5 to 100 and zero never occurs. A higher score means the hero is stronger in that attribute, so highest Strength is the maximum score and dumbest is the minimum Intelligence score.

scope: Ranking or counting heroes by any attribute
description: Only 623 of 750 heroes have attribute score rows, and each rated hero has exactly one score for each of the six attributes. The other 127 heroes cannot appear in any attribute-based ranking, so counts over heroes and counts over hero-attribute rows differ.

scope: Filtering heroes by publisher or comparing publisher counts
description: Publisher labels are full stored strings. Publisher id 4 is DC Comics with 224 heroes and id 13 is Marvel Comics with 387 heroes; there are no standalone DC or Marvel labels. Publisher id 1 has a blank label and covers 17 heroes, and 3 heroes have no publisher at all. Labels are stored capitalised.

scope: Filtering or grouping heroes by gender
description: Gender labels are Male with 519 heroes, Female with 203 and N/A with 28. Matching is on the capitalised stored label.

scope: Filtering heroes by race or species
description: Race labels are stored capitalised: Human covers 219 heroes, Mutant 63, and 58 further species exist. The dash label covers 295 heroes and means the race is not recorded. Lowercase matching such as human will not match the stored Human.

scope: Counting or filtering heroes by superpower
description: 167 distinct powers are defined and 5825 hero-power assignments exist with unique hero-power pairs. Only 652 of 750 heroes have at least one power, and 98 have none, so power-based counts must start from the assignment records or filter hero existence explicitly.

scope: Filtering a single hero by name or listing heroes by name
description: Hero names are not unique: 750 hero rows share 743 distinct names. Atlas occurs 4 times, and Chameleon, Captain Marvel, Ares and Angel occur twice each. Name-based filters can return multiple hero records; use the hero identifier when a single hero is intended.

scope: Cross-attribute comparison involving Speed, Durability, Power or Combat
description: For all 623 rated heroes the Speed, Durability, Power and Combat scores are identical to each other; only Intelligence and Strength differ. Comparisons among those four attributes are therefore not informative.
